metadata.title: Cloud Identity and Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing identity, authentication, and authorization in cloud environments across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS service models.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud-native identity systems, service identities, federation, RBAC, and cross-account authorization.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes trusted identity and access control boundaries across cloud service models and providers.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud identity trust assumptions depend on hosting and jurisdictional context.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Identity and Access defines the foundational trust properties required to govern identity and authorization in cloud environments. This pattern addresses federation, service identities, RBAC, and cross-account access, recognizing identity as the primary cloud security control plane.

components.title: Cloud Identity Federation
components.description: Federated identity and trust relationships between institutional and cloud identity providers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid federated credentials to access cloud resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized governance of cloud access via federated identity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Strong authentication for federated cloud access.
Management of cloud identities and federation trust relationships.
Credential lifecycle management for federated identities.

components.title: Service Identity Governance
components.description: Governance of non-human identities (workloads, services, automation) in cloud environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of service identities or trust policies to gain excessive privileges.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance and least-privilege enforcement for service identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protection of service identity credentials and tokens.
Restricted changes to service identity configurations.

components.title: Cloud Role and Policy Governance
components.description: Creation, assignment, and review of roles, permissions, and trust policies in cloud platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation via over-permissive or misconfigured cloud roles.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governed role design, separation of duties, and periodic access review.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Account and role lifecycle management in cloud platforms.
Enforcement of approved authorizations for cloud access.
Separation of duties for privileged cloud roles.
Least privilege applied to cloud roles and policies.
